question: Does checking a two-signal witness once eliminate enough exact group checks to return a minimum-width verified circuit more cheaply after a parent edit? Can choosing which probes to try add a payable benefit?
inputs: The 36 previously frozen parent circuits and their public histories and independent edits, in the original-physical-piece rendering. Both outputs are Boolean. Old proofs may be acquired from the unedited circuit at measured cost.
forbidden_inputs: Private grade, minimum, planted group, edit kind and future edit are unavailable to deployed methods. Diagnostic ideal-choice arms get only lists of legal pair and outside-setting requests; all truth queries, verification and exact fallback are executed.
outputs: Exact minimum over jointly essential frontier triples, actual NAND program on raw inputs, optional shared witnesses, total CPU, acquisition and fallback counts, residual checks skipped and remaining, cost decomposition.
mapping: Three distinct joint outputs at three assignments differing only in two signals disprove one-bit sufficiency for every group containing those signals. Check each accepted proof once in the verifier. Exact cofactor search, synthesis, global minimality and physical raw/cut validation handle every unresolved obligation.
primary_observable: Paired whole-stream process CPU to return fully verified programs on the saved 36 two-bit edits, including all parent initialization, original proof acquisition, failed probes, fallback, linking, independent checking and serialization. Also evaluate a mixed stream with all 36 one-bit controls.
comparators_or_controls: Frozen fastest ordinary residual-first solver, matched no-proof search, original witnesses rechecked first, deterministic new tests, and favorable exact-verified oracle schedules with no failed discovery. Report attainable union and the actual CPU of partial covers and abstention.
resource_budget: Three existing seeds with 12 parents each. Eight counterbalanced fresh-process repeats per main arm. A second eight blocks resolve a marginal chooser advantage if needed. One pinned CPU. Training has its own conditional identity and fresh, larger wiring.
first_executable_signal: Reproduce fresh, fixed-three and same-four historical coverage with direct observations, then validate smoke returns against the published circuit checker before timing.
stop_rule: Price a genuinely attainable ideal choice with complete verification. Fit a small local policy only if there is a reproducible CPU saving to learn over the strongest deterministic deployment, including the ordinary option. Keep original discovery and independent grades out of deployment inputs.
nonclaims: This tests physical two-output NAND circuits and intermediate three-signal summaries on one bounded family. Coverage alone is not a speedup. A free-advice schedule is not a deployable or learned policy.
